summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the upload directory. It also changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.problem: The download handler joins the name query parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A name like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path such as /etc/passwd escapes the upload directory.
findings.consequence: Any client can read any file the server process can read. That includes secrets, config files and source code.
findings.fix: Resolve the joined path with os.path.realpath and reject it unless it lies under the resolved UPLOAD_DIR. Alternatively, serve the file with flask.send_from_directory.

findings.title: Interactive debugger exposed on all interfaces
findings.problem: The change turns on debug mode and binds the server to 0.0.0.0 instead of 127.0.0.1. The debug mode enables the Werkzeug interactive debugger.
findings.consequence: Anyone on the network who can trigger an error can reach the debugger. That person can then run arbitrary code on the host.
findings.fix: Restore host 127.0.0.1 and remove debug=True. Read both settings from environment configuration if they need to change.

findings.title: Download endpoint has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a new download endpoint with a 404 branch. The repository contains no test that exercises this endpoint.
findings.consequence: A regression in path handling or in the missing-file branch would go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for a valid file, a missing file and a traversal attempt such as ../ in the name.

dropped.reason: The finding raised for the debugger on all interfaces already covers the 0.0.0.0 binding on this line.
This hit repeats the debug=True problem already raised as a finding on this line.
